penalty: mean over examples of mean over valid options of squared mean-centered residual logits
initialization: exact saved E8 zero-output initial-head.pt for every lambda
checkpoint_selection: maximum native development accuracy; earliest epoch ties (E8 rule)
lambda_selection: maximum selected development accuracy, then lower development NLL, then smaller lambda
test_policy: lock winning lambda and checkpoint before reading test features or labels; evaluate only the winner
logging: Publish metrics and configurations to W&B, excluding model checkpoints; preserve full local artifacts
